approach: Add Pageable support to EmployeeController.getAllEmployees()/EmployeeService.getAllEmployees(), backed by a Specification for the optional department/active filters, and introduce a small PageResponse<T> DTO for the envelope.

acceptanceCriteriaPlan.criterion: page/size query params, default 0/20, size capped at 100
acceptanceCriteriaPlan.change: Build a PageRequest from page/size in the controller, clamping size before it reaches the repository.

acceptanceCriteriaPlan.criterion: sort query param restricted to real fields, 400 on bad input
acceptanceCriteriaPlan.change: Whitelist sortable fields; an unknown field/direction throws a validation exception mapped by GlobalExceptionHandler to 400.
Add a JpaSpecification that applies each filter only when the corresponding parameter is present.
Introduce PageResponse<EmployeeResponse> {content, page, size, totalElements, totalPages} and map Page<Employee> into it.
Default Pageable covers the no-params case; no separate code path needed.

risks: Response shape change from a bare array to an envelope is breaking for any existing caller.
testHints: Unit test: unknown sort field returns 400 via GlobalExceptionHandler.
Unit test: department + active filters combine correctly against a mocked repository.
